'''Business and economy'''
*[[Gambling in Brazil]]
**Days before the [[2026 Brazilian general election|general election]], [[Brazilian president]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] issues a [[provisional measure]] banning [[online betting]] in [[Brazil]], immediately halting new deposits. Users may withdraw remaining funds until October 5, and [[Brazilian National Congress|Congress]] must approve the measure within 120 days for it to remain in force.
